definitions.gloss: to install; to set up; to fix in place
definitions.explanation: To permanently place or mount equipment, machinery, or fixtures in a fixed position.

examples.japanese: ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{据|す}え{付|つ}ける。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{据|す}え{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: We installed new machinery in the factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{石灯籠|いしどうろう}→石灯籠：29882_ishidourou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{据|す}え{付|つ}ける⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{半日|はんにち}→半日：27978_hannichi⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took half a day to set up the large stone lantern in the garden.

notes:
A compound verb of ⟦{据|す}える→据える：12796_sueru⟧ (to set, to place) and ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach). Describes the permanent installation or mounting of something heavy or fixed, as opposed to simply placing a portable item.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The intransitive counterpart is ⟦{据|す}え→据える：12796_sueru⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧, though it is rarely used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{据|す}え{付|つ}ける — to install an air conditioner
- ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{据|す}え{付|つ}ける — to install machinery
- {据|す}え{付|つ}け⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ — installation work
- {据|す}え{付|つ}け{型|がた} — built-in type, fixed type

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧ — to set up, to install (more formal/official)
- ⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}ける→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧ — to attach, to install (broader usage, including smaller items)
